description: Fetch an image by URL and get it ready for a vision LLM: auto-rotated, resized to fit max_side (default 1568 px, the size vision models use), re-encoded JPEG/PNG/WebP under 5 MB of base64, with data URI, media type, dimensions and sha256. Input up to 10 MB (jpeg, png, webp, gif, avif, heif, tiff; no SVG). Errors are not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

format.description: Output format (default jpeg; transparency flattened on white)

max_side.description: Longest side in px after resize, 64-4096 (default 1568); never enlarged

quality.description: JPEG/WebP quality 40-95 (default 85; lowered automatically if needed to stay under 5 MB)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (max 10 MB)

name: webtools_image_for_llm
